newsitem.title: USA: US domestic auto sales off 0.6 pct Sept 21-30 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: US domestic auto sales off 0.6 pct Sept 21-30 - CNW.

text.p: U.S. domestic automobile sales slipped 0.6 percent in the last 10 days of September compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research auto sales report released on Wednesday.
Domestic car sales fell to 278,963 in the 10-day survey period, down from 288,316 in the same period of 1995, CNW said. Import car sales fell to 72,086 from 74,013, CNW said.
Domestic truck sales climbed to 218,006 in end-September 1996 from 211,647 end-September 1995, the report said. Import truck sales fell to 17,631 from 18,412, it said.
CNW said 34.8 percent of the vehicles were leased, up from 32.1 percent in the same survey period last year.
About 11.68 million vehicles were sold in the United States from January through September 1996, CNW said.
